summary: Iteration 13 testing PASSED. Backend: 24/24 pytest passed on new suite covering (A) Order Manual: POST /admin/manual unpaid→status manual_unpaid & NOT in bendahara.orders; PUT /admin/manual/{id} with paid+transfer_date+transfer_amount→verified & counted in bendahara with amount=transfer_amount; seats locked via /sessions/1/seats; GET /admin/manual lists correctly; DELETE /admin/orders/{id} soft-deletes (chelyn ok, admin2 without can_delete → 403); unlimited seats (8) allowed; seller & checkin role → 403 on both list and create; (B) Masterlist export type=manual/vip/umum all 200 with PK zip magic; invalid type→400; (C) verified-amount edit-once: create order + verify (admin2, no adjustment) → set-amount 1x OK, 2nd 403 with correct message, superadmin unlimited (3 consecutive edits ok); verify with amount adjustment does NOT consume the edit-once flag (admin can still set-amount 1x afterward — flag only set by set-amount); (D) participants list includes channel field values (umum/panitia/vip/manual). Regression: /api/event 200, duplicate seat POST /api/orders → 409. Frontend UI: chelyn login OK; admin tabs render in order Verifikasi → Bendahara → Tiket VIP → Order Manual → Buka/Tutup → Masterlist → Logs (VIP idx=2 < Manual idx=3 < Sessions idx=4 confirmed). Order Manual tab loads panel with session tabs, seat map, form (manual-name/phone/amount/status-unpaid/paid/transfer-date/transfer-amount/proof/submit). Created a real UI test order picking 2 seats (M21,M20), name+amount+status=unpaid → submit → row appears with 'Belum Bayar' badge; clicked manual-edit-{no} → dialog opens → toggled paid + date 2026-01-20 → save → row badge flipped to 'Sudah Bayar' with transfer date shown; delete via manual-del-{no} removes the row (cleaned up). Masterlist tab shows tables in order Tamu VIP → Order Manual → Pembeli Umum (data-testids masterlist-vip, masterlist-manual, masterlist-umum in that DOM order) with 3 dedicated export buttons masterlist-export-{vip,manual,umum}. CheckinPage: seeded a TEST_ManualBadge paid manual order via backend, opened /checkin as admin1, searched — card renders 'MANUAL' badge (bg-[#B26A1E]/10 orange) next to '#4787' order number as coded in CheckinPage.js L164. VIP badge branch is analogous and rendered by same conditional (o.channel==='vip'). Test manual order deleted post-verification. Verified 'oleh {verified_by} · {time}' small-text under Payment OK is coded in AdminPage.js L2081 conditional on o.verified_by — currently ALL 7 pre-existing verified orders in preview DB have verified_by=null (pre-feature data), so the line legitimately doesn't render on old data; NEW verifications populate verified_by (confirmed by backend test_setup_verified_order asserting verified_by after admin2 POST verify).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js grew to 2486 lines (target <700). Extract ManualPanel, VIPPanel, MasterlistPanel, UsersPanel, BendaharaPanel into /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/*.jsx to satisfy code-review guideline.
server.py at 1917 lines. Consider splitting manual/vip/users/bendahara routers into modules under /app/backend/routers/.

Manual seat locks use expires_at=None (permanent) — deletion soft-deletes order AND frees seats via db.seat_locks.delete_many. OK. However there is no dedicated permission gate on POST/PUT /admin/manual for admin.can_delete — any staff (including chelyn/admin2) can create/edit manual orders. Product spec matches ('admin can use'), but consider adding audit for who edits an already-paid manual order.
list_manual only filters manual:true, deleted:{$ne:True}; does not exclude rejected — currently manual never becomes 'rejected' so fine, but future-proofing may want status filter.

verified_by is only set at verify/reject/manual-paid time; pre-existing verified orders in DB have verified_by=null so the new 'oleh …' UI line renders empty for them. Consider a one-time backfill migration setting verified_by='(sistem)' for legacy verified rows to keep UI consistent for old data.

_manual_counted stores total_amount = order amount when unpaid; this shows non-zero Rp in the Order Manual list for unpaid rows (150.000 in test). If desired, unpaid rows could show '—' or 0 to avoid implying revenue. Minor UX polish.

Seat buttons use data-testid="seat-{LABEL}". Login page has input[placeholder="username"] and input[type="password"].
